Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a severe hallucination in the first step of its analysis. It incorrectly interpreted the search results about "Kaiser Permanente" (founded by Henry J. Kaiser) and "Kaiser Ventures" as being associated with Henry Ford. The search results clearly identified Henry J. Kaiser as the founder and linked him to shipbuilding, but the Planner falsely concluded the founder was Henry Ford (an automotive industrialist) and fabricated details about automotive plants, completely ignoring the correct information present in the search snippet regarding Henry J. Kaiser and shipyards.
